svg.title: Receive, verify and build the renewed chain — instructional mockup
svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Receive, verify and build the renewed chain
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
RHEL 9 — learner@tls-app01
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
scp learner@10.90.0.20:~/tls-ca/public/app-r1.crt ~/tls-work/app-r1.crt
openssl verify -CAfile ~/tls-work/root.crt -untrusted ~/tls-work/intermediate.crt -purpose sslserver
-verify_hostname app.example.mil ~/tls-work/app-r1.crt
set -o pipefail
openssl x509 -in ~/tls-work/app-r1.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | openssl
dgst -sha256
sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/pki/tls/private/app-v1.key -pubout -outform DER | openssl dgst -sha256
cat ~/tls-work/app-r1.crt ~/tls-work/intermediate.crt > ~/tls-work/app-r1-fullchain.pem
sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 ~/tls-work/app-r1-fullchain.pem
/etc/pki/tls/certs/app-r1-fullchain.pem
sudo restorecon -v /etc/pki/tls/certs/app-r1-fullchain.pem
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
The leaf verifies, the public-key digests match and the new fullchain is staged.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Copy the new leaf, verify trust and name, then compare its public key digest with app-v1.key.
2. Only if both fingerprints match and validation says OK should you assemble and install the renewed
public chain.
3. Keep the old v1 certificate and key protected for rollback while they are still valid and policy
permits.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
